[[Borrguus Blisterbark]] is an [[Elemental]] [[boss]] who spawns in the burning forest in southeastern [[Sacnoth Valley]]. He is in a group with three to four [[Burning Spirit]]s, making their combined use of [[Searing Flames]] very deadly without appropriate countermeasures.

== Notes ==
* Care must be taken with this group (and the other groups of Burning Spirits), as they have a wide patrol range and can quickly ambush and wipe your group while fighting other enemies.  They are also highly resistant to fire damage and immune to burning, so other categories of elemental spells should be used against them.  
* Consider bringing AoE interrupts such as [[Cry of Frustration]], [[Tease]], or a ranger with [[Choking Gas]]. 
:* The interrupt [[Complicate]], when used on Searing Flames, is particularly effective as it will shut down the entire mob's main source of damage.
* [[Hex Eater Vortex]]  and [[Shatter Hex]] can also be useful in removing Mark of Rodgort from melee characters and dealing large armor-ignoring damage to nearby foes. 
* Pre-interrupts such as [[Guilt]] and [[Mistrust]] can help in interrupting the multiple copies of Searing Flames.
* [[Winter]] will prevent Mark of Rodgort and the [[spike]] damage from Searing Flames from triggering and significantly boost damage from your elemental sources.
* Elementalists should consider bringing [[Frigid Armor]] to effectively prevent any damage from [[Searing Flames]].

== Trivia ==
* This boss was named by Moses Fiellau-Nikolajsen through the 2007 [[Eye of the North Brand the Boss (2007)|Brand The Boss]] contest.
